newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle lower - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers traded moderately active, USDA said. Compared to last Wednesday, both classes were $1.00-1.50 lower, instances $2.00 lower.
Slaughter Steers: Few lots Choice 3 old crop 1350-1400 lbs 67.00-67.50. High Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1400 lbs 66.00-67.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 65.00-66.00. Select 1-2 63.50-65.00.

Slaughter Heifers: Part load Choice 3 Blacks near 1150 lbs old crop 67.50. High Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 65.00-66.50. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 64.00-65.00. Select 1-2 63.00-64.00.
